notes: Fixed replies failing to send with a bare HTTP 413 error. Pasting an image into a reply now shrinks it first instead of embedding it at full size, which was silently blocking the entire send once the image was large enough.

windows_notes: Replying to an auto-generated takedown ticket now actually reaches the artist, instead of going to a system address nobody reads.
